entries.name: Catch-up (stick-slip)
entries.summary: The bet that a quiet stock catches up with its linked stocks. Over 2024 to 2026 the pull of linked stocks did not predict a quiet stock's later move (its t-values, a measure of how clearly an effect stands out from chance, were −0.7 and −0.8; 3.0 was needed), and the real map beat 7 of 20 maps with shuffled links (19 were needed).

entries.name: How attention spreads: who turns loud next (version 1)
entries.summary: It forecasts which quiet stocks turn loud within the next 5 trading days. On the explored years its mean weekly skill over the plain guess was 0.0000 (t-value −2.1) (a fault check, not a test; rehearsed on 2019 to 2023). The real map beat 13 of 20 shuffled maps; what the links add beyond the sector averaged 0.0000 a week (t-value 0.2). With shared stories not removed: mean weekly skill over the plain guess 0.0000 (t-value −2.2). The real map beat 20 of 20 shuffled maps; what the links add beyond the sector averaged 0.0000 a week (t-value 1.6). On live days it forecasts with shared-news overlap not removed. The closed years: not looked at. Live so far: no weeks scored yet.
